notablePrerequisites:
Pirated Copy is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Pirated Copy do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Pirated Copy.
Activate Pirated Copy by tapping it.
When Pirated Copy becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Pirated Copy's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
